name: Koi Iro After School
original_name: 恋色アフタースクール
source:
You are a newbie teacher who has just begun working at a new school.

You meet three cute students at your new school!!
Each with their own special traits, you’ll have your hands full in your new life as a teacher!!

Well then, with all it’s ups and downs, how will you live your life as a teacher?

[From Google Play]
translation:
你是一名刚到新学校任教的新手教师。

在新学校里，你遇见三名可爱的学生！！
每个人都有自己的个性，你的新教师生活将忙得不可开交！！

那么，在有起有落的日子里，你会如何度过教师生涯？

[来源：Google Play]
